verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state OpenCode can be asked to fix an issue or implement a feature, working in a new branch and submitting a PR with all changes, and it integrates with GitHub Actions via /opencode mentions to run tasks end-to-end. This directly covers issue-to-PR automation, though evidence is vendor-documented only without independent hands-on confirmation of the full issue-to-PR flow succeeding. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of a successful end-to-end issue-to-PR run, and detail on how issue tracking (e.g., linking to GitHub issues specifically) is handled beyond the GitHub Actions integration.
